phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Global Business Foundations & Self-Discovery — Build business literacy, explore international management careers, and develop cross-cultural awareness.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and international career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to international business career pathways including global operations, export management, diplomatic service, and multinational management.

milestones.label: Explore management principles in a global context
milestones.description: Introduction to management functions with emphasis on how planning, organizing, leading, and controlling vary across cultural and geographic contexts. Students analyze multinational management case studies.

milestones.label: Build financial literacy foundations
milestones.description: Introduction to financial statements and the accounting cycle. Students build the financial literacy needed to analyze international business performance and cross-border transactions.

milestones.label: Join International Business Club or AIESEC
milestones.description: Join an internationally-focused student organization such as AIESEC, International Business Club, or Model UN. Attend cultural events and engage with international students to build cross-cultural competency.

milestones.label: Analyze global economic forces and trade patterns
milestones.description: Examine international trade theory, comparative advantage, exchange rates, and global economic institutions. Students analyze how global economic forces create business opportunities and risks.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Cross-Cultural Management & Applied Learning — Deepen organizational behavior knowledge and build international professional networks.

milestones.label: Master organizational behavior across cultures
milestones.description: Study individual and group behavior in organizations with emphasis on how cultural dimensions (Hofstede, GLOBE) influence motivation, communication, leadership, and team dynamics in multinational settings.

milestones.label: Begin foreign language proficiency development
milestones.description: Begin or advance proficiency in a foreign language (Spanish, French, Mandarin, Arabic, or other) essential for international business communication. Target working proficiency by graduation.

milestones.label: Attend CoBE career fair and multinational recruiting events
milestones.description: Participate in career fairs and recruiting events with multinational corporations, international NGOs, and government agencies with global operations. Practice cross-cultural networking skills.

milestones.label: Analyze international marketing and global consumer behavior
milestones.description: Study marketing principles with emphasis on global market segmentation, international branding, and cross-cultural consumer behavior. Students compare marketing strategies across national markets.

milestones.label: Participate in international service-learning project
milestones.description: Partner with an international or multicultural community organization to address an operational challenge. Apply operations management tools while developing cross-cultural collaboration skills.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: International Management Specialization — Study abroad, master international strategy, and gain global professional experience.

milestones.label: Complete study abroad or international exchange program
milestones.description: Participate in a semester-long or summer study abroad program at a partner university. Immerse in a foreign business environment, complete coursework, and develop intercultural competency through lived experience.

milestones.label: Master international strategic management
milestones.description: Study strategic management frameworks for multinational enterprises including global integration vs. local responsiveness, international market entry modes, and cross-border alliance management.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with a global industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a mentorship with a manager in international business, global supply chain, or diplomatic service through CoBE networks. Focus monthly discussions on global career navigation.

milestones.label: Complete summer international internship
milestones.description: Secure an internship with a multinational corporation, international NGO, or government agency with global operations. Apply cross-cultural management skills in a professional setting abroad or with international teams.

milestones.label: Complete cross-cultural management simulation
milestones.description: Participate in an immersive cross-cultural management simulation involving negotiation, team leadership, and decision-making across culturally diverse virtual teams. Analyze cultural intelligence dimensions.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Finalize global career readiness, complete capstone, and launch international career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone international consulting project
milestones.description: Collaborate with a client organization facing international business challenges. Conduct cross-border market research, develop global strategy recommendations, and present findings to faculty and industry panelists.

milestones.label: Complete international salary and expatriate package evaluation
milestones.description: Workshops covering international compensation packages, expatriate benefits, cost-of-living adjustments, and cross-border tax implications. Develop a personal global career strategy.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor for underclassmen
milestones.description: Mentor first- or second-year international management students, sharing study abroad experiences, internship strategies, and cross-cultural professional development insights.

milestones.label: Develop global career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package for international roles including multilingual resume, cross-cultural competency portfolio, and documented global professional network. Target multinational employers.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Management Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting international job offers, graduate school admissions, or fellowship placements.
